category.description: One category. Goods: electronics (electronics & accessories), fashion (clothing & shoes), jewelry (jewelry, bags & accessories), beauty (beauty & personal care), home (home & living), toys (toys & games), baby (baby & maternity), sports (sports & outdoor gear), hobbies (collectibles & hobbies), art (art, handmade & craft supplies), pets (pet supplies), books (books, music & movies), food (food & drinks). Services: lessons (lessons & tutoring), local (local services: repairs, cleaning, moving, pet care, babysitting, beauty, photography), creative (design, writing, translation, video, music), professional (software, AI setup, marketing, legal, accounting). digital (templates, e-books, courses, apps, AI agent skills, media files), rentals (tickets & vouchers), other.

city.description: City for in-person listings, e.g. "San Francisco" or "Portland, OR". In-person listings in that city come first, then those nearby (same metro area or within about 30 miles); listings done only in person elsewhere are left out. Add the state when several places share the name. In-person listings without a city are kept and marked city_unknown (unless they ship); online, either-way and shipped listings are always included and rank after local ones.

condition.description: Physical items: new = only new items; used = new and used. Listings that don't state a condition are included.

delivery.description: onsite = in person only, remote = online only, hybrid = either.

max_price.description: Highest price in USD (per the listing's unit).

min_price.description: Lowest price in USD (per the listing's unit).

query.description: What your user wants, in a few words, e.g. "spanish lessons for kids", "used fujifilm camera", "logo design", "road bike tune-up". Matched as whole words and their word forms (lesson / lessons, colorized / colorization) against listing titles and descriptions; a word naming a category (pets, electronics, fashion, clothing, jewelry, makeup, furniture, toys, baby, camping, hobbies, crafts, books, food, tickets, rentals, templates, video, or the same in Chinese, Japanese or Korean) also matches listings in that category. Store names, intros and listing cities are not matched (put places in city). Rarer words count more, and listings that match only common words are left out. Online, remote and in person never bring in a listing by themselves: among equally good matches, listings whose title says it come first, then those delivered that way (either-way listings count as both). To keep only one kind use delivery, which is exact: delivery=remote leaves out either-way listings. Only the first 12 search words are used, so put the most important first. Write abbreviations in capitals (QA, PR, IT).

ship_to_country.description: Your user's country as a 2-letter ISO code (US, CA, GB for the United Kingdom), when you know it: only listings that can be shipped there come back (services, digital goods and in-person listings are kept). If nothing that matches ships there, note says how many match but ship elsewhere.

store.description: Only this seller's storefront (the store name after egonex.shop/@).

name: search_offers

browse_url.description: When nothing matched: the sellers directory for people.

categories.description: When nothing matched: categories that have listings.

next_offset.description: Pass as offset for the next page; null = no more.

note.description: How the results were found, when not every word matched or nothing did (or nothing that matches ships to ship_to_country), or not every word was used.

ask_url.description: Link a person can open to ask the seller on Egonex.

availability.description: in_stock, or sold_out (can't be ordered until the seller restocks; sold-out listings are left out of search, you only see them when you fetch one by id).

brand.description: Physical items: brand, as the seller gave it; absent when not stated.

city_unknown.description: true = in person, the seller did not give a city and it doesn't ship; ask before suggesting it to someone far away.

delivery.description: For a service: onsite (in person), remote (online) or hybrid (either). Physical items always ship (remote).

delivery_days.description: The seller's usual delivery time in days (for shipped items, days to ship); absent when not stated.

digital_delivery.description: Digital products: the seller sends a file or a link after payment.

digital_format.description: Digital products: the file type; absent when not stated.

gtin.description: Physical items: barcode (UPC / EAN / ISBN, 8–14 digits, check digit verified) when the seller gave it.

kind.description: What it is: physical (an item; it always ships), service, or digital (a file or link the seller sends by hand after payment).

matched_words.description: Search results only: the words of query this listing's title or description (or its category, for a category name such as pets) matches, as written in query. Chinese, Japanese and Korean text is matched in overlapping two-character pieces, and these are what is listed.

missing_words.description: Search results only: the words of query this listing doesn't match (for Chinese, Japanese and Korean, two-character pieces); absent when it matches them all. A some_words listing without missing_words matched every word, but either it is not delivered the way the query asked (online, remote or in person) or some words of the query could not be searched.

model.description: Physical items: model name or number, as the seller gave it; match it to compare the exact version.

options.description: Only for a listing with options (size, color...): each option and its values, in the order of a variant's values.

values.description: Its values, e.g. S, M, L.

order_url.description: Link a person can open to order on Egonex.

photos.description: Up to 4 photo URLs; the first is the cover.

text.description: The price as text, e.g. "$1,150 per item".

unit.description: What the price is per: item, package, hour, day, week, month, night, person, project or time (a session).

relevance.description: Search results only: all_words (the listing itself, not its store's name or intro, matched every search word and, if the query said online, remote or in person, it is delivered that way or its title says so; either-way listings fit both), some_words or other_filters (no word matched; another listing in the category or store searched).

seller.description: The seller (only what is on their public page).

answers_questions.description: true = the seller's assistant (Ego) answers ask_seller right away.

average_rating.description: Average star rating of the counted reviews, 1 to 5 with one decimal (shown as ★ 4.8 on Egonex); present with review_count.

negative_count.description: Counted reviews with 1 to 3 stars; present with review_count, 0 included.

orders_completed.description: Orders completed on Egonex; only present from 3.

positive_count.description: Counted reviews with 4 or 5 stars; present with review_count, 0 included.

positive_rate.description: Percent of counted reviews with 4 or 5 stars, 0 to 100, rounded down; only present from 10 counted reviews.

review_count.description: Counted buyer reviews (buyers rate the item they bought from 1 to 5 stars); only present from 1.

trusted.description: true = the seller has Egonex's Trusted badge, the same one shown on their public page. Egonex gives it automatically when the seller's recent trading on Egonex reaches the top earn-back step (sellers can't set it), and doesn't show it while their account health is low.

session_minutes.description: Services priced per session or per hour: how long one session is, in minutes.

shipping.description: Items that ship, when the seller set a shipping fee or limits where it ships: the fee is charged once per order whatever the quantity, paid at Egonex checkout and by pay_order. Absent when neither is set.

fee.description: The shipping fee in USD for the order; absent when free.

international_fee.description: Older listings only: the fee to other countries (fee is then the fee inside the seller's country).

no_international.description: Older listings only: true = it doesn't ship to other countries.

ships_to.description: Only for items that ship to some countries only: the 2-letter country codes (ISO 3166-1) it ships to. Absent = it ships to every country Egonex checkout ships to. Check your user's country before recommending it.

items.description: A 2-letter country code, for example US.

ships.description: true = the seller ships it; your user enters the shipping address when paying on Egonex, or you pass it to pay_order when you pay.

stock_left.description: Only present when 1 to 3 are left (for a limited service, orders left); no number otherwise. Absent for a listing with options: see each variant.

variants.description: Only for a listing with options: the combinations your user can choose. Pass the chosen one's id as variant_id to quote_order and request_order. price above is then the lowest variant price.

label.description: The values joined, e.g. Black / M.

text.description: The price as text, e.g. "$1,150 per item".

unit.description: What the price is per: item, package, hour, day, week, month, night, person, project or time (a session).

stock_left.description: Only present when 1 to 3 of this variant are left.

values.description: One value per option, in the order of options.

searched_as.description: Only when Egonex searched a rewrite of query (it isn't in English, has words too short to search, ends with a place, nothing matched, or one of its words appears in no listing): what was searched. matched_words and missing_words are in the words of the search that found the listing: the rewrite, or, for a query that isn't in English, the query as written.

city.description: City read from query and used as the city filter; a short form such as sf comes back as the full name (San Francisco, CA).

delivery.description: Delivery read from query: listings delivered that way rank first (either-way listings count); it does not filter.

max_price.description: Highest price read from query and used as a filter.

min_price.description: Lowest price read from query and used as a filter.

query.description: The English search words that were used.

total.description: How many listings match in all.

unused_words.description: Words of query that were not used: only the first 12 search words count. Search again with them if they matter.

title: Search Egonex listings
